tagline: Web scraping and search for remote teammates — every call burns API credits.
requirements: Set FIRECRAWL_API_KEY in the host environment (set FIRECRAWL_API_URL for a self-hosted instance). The official server registers about 29 tools; this guide documents the most relevant ones. Every request consumes Firecrawl credits.

tools.name: firecrawl_scrape
tools.note: Fetches one page as markdown or structured data.

tools.name: firecrawl_search
tools.note: Web search with scraped page content in the results.

tools.name: firecrawl_map
tools.note: Lists the URL structure of a site.

tools.name: firecrawl_check_crawl_status
tools.note: Checks the status of a running crawl job.

tools.name: firecrawl_crawl
tools.note: Crawls many pages — can consume significant credits.

tools.name: firecrawl_agent
tools.note: Launches a multi-step agentic research job that runs unsupervised and burns credits.

tools.name: firecrawl_research_search_papers
tools.note: Deep research over academic papers; expensive in credits.

tools.name: firecrawl_monitor_create
tools.note: Creates persistent site monitors that keep polling.

tools.name: firecrawl_interact
tools.note: Drives a live browser session on a remote page — clicks and form input included.

tools.name: firecrawl_feedback
tools.note: Submits feedback associated with your account.

seo.description: Share the official Firecrawl MCP server with MCPWire. Configure the API key on the host, let teammates scrape and search the web over P2P, and keep crawl and agent jobs behind approval.
